Definition: Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Beer-lahai-roi is the well of Him that lives and sees me. It is named where Hagar meets the angel in the wilderness, where Isaac dwells when he meets Rebekah, and where God blesses Isaac after Abraham's death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this well is the most tender place name in Genesis, because a runaway servant names it for the God who saw her, and the same well shelters Isaac for the rest of his life. The God who lives and sees is still the God who meets the runaway, and I hold that no one is ever out of His sight.
